portal_description:
Evolution is a GNOME application that provides integrated email, calendar, contact management, and communications functionality.

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* Evolution - Composer: Cursor jumps over characters when using backspace or delete (JIRA:RHEL-58684)

* Evolution - Composer: Cursor jumps to the starting line when "return" key is pressed at the end of the line. (JIRA:RHEL-58689)

* WebKitGTK 2.46.1: Middle mouse button inserts primary clipboard twice (JIRA:RHEL-62683)
